body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Dell(www.dell.com) introduced 4-inch Android smartphone 'Venue Pro' with 'QSD8250', a 'Snapdragon' processor of Qualcomm at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA, for 4 days from January 6.
'Venue Pro' is features 4-inch touch display and qwerty keypad and has been released recently at Korean market with 5-inch Tablet phone 'Streak'.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
